data.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Teams Up With Kawasaki To Build AI Powered Shipyard Robots
data.description: Nvidia and Kawasaki Heavy Industries have agreed to co-develop AI-powered robotics for shipbuilding in Japan. The partners plan to build a next-generation digital shipyard that uses robotics, AI and simulation technologies. The collaboration extends Nvidia’s AI platform into industrial robotics and shipbuilding applications. Nvidia, traded as NasdaqGS:NVDA, is best known for its GPUs and broader AI computing stack that supports data centers and advanced computing workloads. This new...
